answer: Require each agent to verify a unique mobile number with a one-time code, so every identity sits at a vertex anchored to one carrier-checked SIM. Prepaid SIMs cost about $3 each and carriers limit bulk buys, so even at the nadir of prices a farmer wanting 2,000 fake voices spends roughly $6,000. Numbers idle for 90 days are re-checked, so a stockpile of old SIMs turns into a hollow reserve that cannot vote for free.
